info.title: DDADAN Coupon API
info.description: 상점별 쿠폰·도장 발급 시스템 API. 모든 경로는 `/api/coupon/v1` 아래에 있으며, JSON 필드는 snake_case, 식별자는 UUID 문자열, 시각은 RFC 3339 UTC, 금액은 원 단위 정수입니다.

post.summary: Simulate a correction before anyone is allowed to run it (ADMIN-003, §13.4).
post.description:
Restricted to the roles §3.3 lets request a correction; approving and executing one is
a separate act with its own separation-of-duties rule.

201.description: A snapshot of what the correction would do

403.description: This role may not request corrections

get.summary: One transaction, its ledger and its whole event history (§2.1 목표 5).
get.description:
Readable by every administrative role: answering "what happened to this customer" is
support's daily work, and the response carries no unmasked personal data.

get.summary:
Liveness. Touches nothing external on purpose: a dependency outage must not make the
orchestrator kill a healthy process.

404.description: Signed in but not bootstrapped yet

409.description: Someone else changed the profile first

get.summary: My current consent state, including scopes I have never touched.

post.summary: Grant or revoke consent. Each change appends an immutable event (§9.4).

422.description: Required consent cannot be revoked here

post.summary: Issue a 60-second rotating QR and its manual code.
post.description:
Rate limited to 20/minute per user (§16.4): a legitimate screen refreshes every 30
seconds, so anything approaching the ceiling is a script harvesting nonces.

403.description: The account may not present a QR

get.summary: My active roles, with the store each store-scoped role refers to.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description:
`AVAILABLE`, `HISTORY` or `ALL`. Defaults to `ALL` — the wallet never hides a
benefit, it only groups it (§6.2).

get.summary: One coupon, with the conditions frozen at issuance and its full history.

404.description: No such coupon, or it is not the caller's

get.summary: My stamp boards, one per store.

409.description: The name is already used in this store

404.description: No such category in this store

parameters.name: include_inactive
parameters.description:
Include deactivated items. Off by default, because the common case is picking an
item for a new policy, where only active items may be chosen (§8.3).

409.description: The SKU is already in use

patch.summary: Edit a catalogue item, including deactivating it.

404.description: No such item in this store

get.summary: Every version of my stamp policy.

400.description: A value is outside its §8.1 range

patch.summary: Edit a draft. An active version is never edited in place (STAMP-008).

422.description: This version is not a draft

post.summary: Publish a draft, now or at a chosen instant.

400.description: The reward is missing wording customers must see

post.summary: Read a customer's QR and describe who they are — pseudonymously (§11.4, WALLET-005).
post.description: Does not consume the QR: the owner may still abandon the sale.

409.description: That QR has already been used

422.description: The QR could not be accepted

201.description: Stamps granted, and any reward earned

409.description: The QR was already used, or this looks like a duplicate

422.description: A policy condition is not met

post.summary: Check an order against the active policy and show what would happen.
post.description:
Returns 200 with `approvable: false` and the reasons when the accrual would be
refused, because the scan screen has to display them (§6.3).

422.description: The QR or the store state makes a preview impossible

post.summary: Reverse an accrual within the owner's own window (STAMP-007).

404.description: No such accrual in this store

422.description: Past the window, or a reward has moved on

post.summary: Create my store draft. One per account (§12.6-1).

409.description: This account already has a store, or the slug is taken
Someone else changed the store first

422.description: The store cannot be edited in its current state

post.description:
High-risk: it freezes the business identity a reviewer will act on, so it requires a
recent sign-in (§9.3).

403.description: Sign-in is too old for this operation

post.summary: Create the internal account for a signed-in Firebase user.

401.description: Missing or invalid Firebase ID token

AdjustmentPreview.description: What running the correction would do — and what must not have changed by then.

affected_coupon_ids.description: Rewards the correction would have to take back.

blockers.description: Reasons the correction cannot be run as described.

ledger_entries_to_append.description: The ledger rows the correction would append. Nothing is ever rewritten.

observed_versions.description:
The `version` of every mutable row this correction depends on. If any of them has
moved when execution is attempted, the preview is stale and must be retaken.

preview_expires_at.description: After this, the preview must be taken again (§13.4).

snapshot_taken_at.description:
Taken inside a `REPEATABLE READ` transaction, so every number below is one
consistent picture rather than a series of separate reads (§13.4).

case_id.description:
The case this correction belongs to. §11.5 requires an adjustment to hang off a
case, not to appear from nowhere.

AdminLedgerEntry.description: One entry of the append-only stamp ledger, as an investigator reads it.

AdminRewardSummary.description: A reward this transaction created, and where it ended up.

AdminTransactionDetail.description: `GET /admin/transactions/:id` — one id, the whole story (§2.1 목표 5).

customer_key.description: The customer's pseudonymous key. Never their email, phone or name (§11.5 마스킹).

timeline.description: Everything above, merged in time order.

display_name.description: Defaults to the Firebase display name, then to a generated nickname.

registration_no.description: 사업자등록번호. Stored encrypted plus a keyed hash for duplicate detection.

reference_price.description: Reference price only. The price that counts is the one entered at the till (§8.3).

sku.description: The store's own SKU. Optional — most small shops do not have one (§8.3).

acknowledge_duplicate.description:
Approve despite a duplicate warning, having entered a distinct order reference
(STAMP-003).

preview_id.description:
Echoed from the preview. Recorded for support, never trusted as a substitute for
re-validation (§11.4).

document_version.description: Version label of the document shown to the user, e.g. `2026-08-01`.

source.description: The screen that collected the consent (§9.4), e.g. `signup`, `settings/alerts`.

store_id.description: Required for store-scoped consent, rejected otherwise.

ConsentScope.description: The consent scopes from the §9.4 table.

ConsentState.description: One consent as it stands right now, derived from the latest event.

CouponStatusEvent.description: One state change, for the "what happened to my coupon" history.

ends_at.description: Optional absolute end of the version.

slug.description:
Public URL segment. Validated by [`ensure_valid_slug`], which mirrors the
`ck_stores_slug_format` CHECK constraint.

ErrorBody.description: Wire shape of a failure. Matches the example in §11.1 exactly.

FieldError.description: One invalid field, for a form to highlight.

active_policy_id.description: The version accruals are being judged against right now, if any.

scheduled_policy_id.description: The version that takes over at its `starts_at` (§6.3 shows this as "다음 예약").

LoyaltyPolicy.description: One version, as the owner app sees it.

OrderInput.description: The order as the owner typed it (§11.4 적립 승인 요청 예시).

external_order_ref.description:
Optional POS reference. STAMP-003 uses a *new* one as the owner's confirmation
that a near-duplicate really is a separate order.

OrderItemInput.description: One `order.items[]` entry from a scan request (§11.4).

catalog_item_id.description: Optional: an owner may type an item that is not in the catalogue.

effective_status.description:
What it means right now — `EXPIRED` once the clock has passed `expires_at`, even
if the sweep has not caught up (§18.1).

revocation_reason.description: Why it was taken away. Shown rather than hidden (§6.2).

next_cursor.description: Pass back as `?cursor=` to fetch the next page. `null` on the last page.

PolicyRules.description: Everything a draft or an active version says about earning a stamp.

daily_earning_limit.description: Accruals per business day, 1–20. `None` means unlimited (§8.1).

PreviewIssue.description: One reason an accrual cannot be approved as submitted.

PseudonymousCustomer.description:
What the owner is allowed to know about the customer in front of them (§3.1,
WALLET-005).

Every field here is either store-local or masked. There is deliberately no email, no
phone number, no Kakao identifier, and nothing about any other store.

alias.description: Stable store-local nickname, derived rather than taken from the profile.

store_customer_id.description: Store-scoped pseudonymous id. `None` until the customer's first accrual here.

effective_at.description: When the version takes over. Absent or in the past means immediately.

fallback_code.description: Eight digits for STORE-005, when the camera is unavailable.

key_id.description: Which signing key produced this token (§16.2).

refresh_after_seconds.description: Seconds after which the screen should request a replacement.

token.description: The signed payload to render as a QR code.

status.description: `ready` or `not_ready`. `degraded` components do not change it.

RewardDefinition.description: The reward a completed board pays out.

customer_notice.description: The notice STAMP-001 requires before a policy may go live.

description.description: The usage conditions in the customer's words.

store_id.description: Set for store-scoped roles. Phase 1 grants only account-wide roles.

ScanRequest.description: How the owner identified the customer. Exactly one must be present.

fallback_code.description: The eight digits from the customer's screen (STORE-005).

qr_token.description: The signed payload read from the camera.

qr_expires_at.description: When the presented QR stops being usable, so the owner knows how long they have.

self_transaction.description:
True when the owner is scanning their own consumer profile (SEC-004). Not blocked,
but recorded and shown.

StampBoard.description: The stamp board as both apps render it (§8.1: `N/10`, 가장 이른 도장 만료).

earliest_expiry.description: The soonest any currently-held stamp expires.

expiring_within_seven_days.description: Stamps that expire within seven days (§6.2 홈 우선 노출).

remaining_to_goal.description: How many more stamps until the next reward.

StampPreview.description:
`POST /owner/stamp-transactions/preview` (§11.4).

Returns 200 even when the accrual would be refused, with the reasons listed: the scan
screen's REVIEW step has to *show* why (§6.3), and an error response cannot carry the
customer and board context it needs to do that. `confirm` re-checks everything, so a
stale or forged preview buys nothing (§11.4).

blockers.description: Blocking. `approvable` is false whenever this is non-empty.

eligible_amount.description: The part of the order that counts, after item restrictions (§8.3).

next_business_day_start.description: Start of the next business day, for the "come back tomorrow" message (STAMP-005).

stamps_expire_at.description: When the stamps this order would grant expire.

warnings.description: Non-blocking: shown to the owner before they approve (STAMP-003, SEC-004).

StampTransaction.description: The result of `POST /owner/stamp-transactions` and of a reversal.

revoked_reward_ids.description: Rewards taken back by a reversal (STAMP-007).

voidable_until.description: Until when the owner may still reverse this themselves (§8.6).

business_day_cutoff.description: Local time a business day rolls over, `HH:MM:SS`.

business_profile_complete.description: Whether the encrypted business-identity record has been filled in.

public_reason.description: Reason shown to the owner. Internal reviewer notes are never returned here.

TimelineEvent.description: One thing that happened, from whichever table recorded it.

oneOf.description: Deactivating keeps the item in every snapshot that already names it (§8.3).

version.description: Expected `version`; may also be supplied as `If-Match`.

oneOf.description: Business identity, required before review. Encrypted at rest (§16.5).

version.description: Expected `version`; may also be supplied as `If-Match`.

consumer_key.description:
Stable pseudonymous identifier. Safe to show a store owner; never put it in a QR
payload (§16.2).

effective_status.description:
What it means right now — `EXPIRED` once the clock has passed `expires_at`, even
if the sweep has not caught up (§18.1).

revocation_reason.description: Why it was taken away. Shown rather than hidden (§6.2).

condition_snapshot.description:
The conditions frozen at issuance. A later policy edit does not change them
(§8.5).

WalletStampBoard.description: One store's board in the wallet (§8.1: `N/10`, 가장 이른 도장 만료, 리워드 내용).

as_of.description: Server time the balances were judged against, so a client can show staleness.
